description: This file provides a Python interface for interacting with the Soong build system. It defines a class 'Soong' with methods to execute build commands, query build variables, and clean build output directories, along with utility functions such as logger.

classes.name: Soong
classes.description: A class encapsulating methods to interact with the Soong build system, including executing commands, querying variables, creating build targets, and cleaning output directories.

methods.name: logging.Logger logger()
methods.description: Returns the module level logger instance.

methods.name: Soong.__init__
methods.description: Initializes the Soong object with paths to the build top directory and output directory.

methods.name: Soong.soong_ui
methods.description: Executes the soong_ui.bash script with specified arguments and environment variables, returning the command output.

methods.name: Soong.get_make_var
methods.description: Queries a build variable's value from the build system.

methods.name: Soong.clean
methods.description: Removes the output directory if it exists.

methods.name: Soong.build
methods.description: Builds specified targets, creating the output directory if necessary.
